payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Coralee, Della, Lorean

payload.content: Hi team! Della here. I'm frontend-skilled with 5h availability. Looking at ISSUE-0001 tasks (all critical priority). My best options are triage (1.6h, cost 2.08) or review/docs (2h each, cost ~2.6). The implement task (4h, cost 5.21) would push my limits. ISSUE-0002 tasks are too far from my skills. What are you thinking?

Hi Della! Coralee here. I'm UI-UX design skilled with 6h availability. ISSUE-0002 (Fix ui-ux-design) matches my skills perfectly - I'm looking at either the review task (2.5h effort, cost 5.20) or test task (3.5h effort, cost 7.27). Since you're handling the ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks, I'll take one of the ISSUE-0002 tasks. Which would you prefer to leave for me, or do you have other plans? Also waiting to hear from Lorean on their preferences.

Update: After reviewing costs more carefully, the ISSUE-0002 review task (2.5h, cost 5.20) is my most efficient option - it fits well within my 6h availability and leverages my UI-UX skills. The test task (3.5h, cost 7.27) would also work but is less optimal. I'm leaning toward the review task unless Lorean needs it or there are other coordination needs. Della, are you planning to take the ISSUE-0001 triage task (1.6h) as your best fit?

Hi Della and Coralee! Lorean here. I have 8h availability and strong frontend skills. Looking at the critical ISSUE-0001 tasks, I can efficiently handle several: triage (1.6h, cost 1.51), review/docs (2h each, cost 1.89), or test (2.8h, cost 2.64). The implement task (4h, cost 3.77) also fits well. Since ISSUE-0002 tasks are expensive for me due to limited ui-ux skills, I'll focus on ISSUE-0001. Della, since you're considering triage or review/docs, and those are my lowest cost options too, how about I take the test task (2.8h) or implement task (4h)? That would leave the shorter tasks for you while ensuring we complete the critical work efficiently. What do you think?

Hi Lorean! Thanks for the thoughtful coordination. I like your plan - you taking test (2.8h) or implement (4h) would work well. Given my 5h limit, I'm leaning toward triage (1.6h, cost 2.08) as my most efficient option, leaving review/docs for potential flexibility. This way we maximize critical task completion without overlap. Sound good? Coralee, does this leave you clear for ISSUE-0002 review task?

Lorean and Della, your coordination plan looks solid! To summarize: Della takes ISSUE-0001 triage (1.6h), Lorean takes either test (2.8h) or implement (4h) from ISSUE-0001, and I'll take ISSUE-0002 review (2.5h). This covers 3 critical tasks efficiently. Lorean, which of the two ISSUE-0001 tasks are you leaning toward? Also, I want to confirm - are we all set with this allocation, or do we need to consider any other factors before execution? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Actually, let me double-check something - are there any other blackboards we should be coordinating on? I want to make sure we're not missing any communication channels before we finalize our plan. Also, Lorean, have you decided between the ISSUE-0001 test task (2.8h) vs implement task (4h)? Both seem like good fits for your frontend skills and availability. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Thanks Coralee! Looking at the remaining ISSUE-0001 options, I'm leaning toward the implement task (4h, cost 3.77) since it's the highest priority critical task and I have the availability and frontend skills to complete it efficiently. This would leave the test task available if anyone else wants it, but I think taking the implement task gives us the best value for our critical path. To confirm our plan: Della takes ISSUE-0001 triage (1.6h), I take ISSUE-0001 implement (4h), and you take ISSUE-0002 review (2.5h). This covers the most critical work with optimal skill matching. Are we all aligned for execution?

I should also check - are there any other blackboards or communication channels we need to coordinate on? I want to make sure we're not missing any stakeholders or dependencies before we finalize our assignments.

Actually, let me check if there are other blackboards I should be communicating on. Since I only see blackboard 0 in my view, I'll post there to ensure we're covering all coordination channels. If there are other blackboards with different participants viewing the same tasks, we need to make sure they know our intended assignments to avoid conflicts.

Coralee and Lorean - confirming my plan to take ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6h). This is my most efficient critical task option given my 5h availability and frontend skills. Lorean, your plan for implement (4h) and Coralee for ISSUE-0002 review (2.5h) sounds optimal. We're aligned for execution phase.

Checking if there are other blackboards I should coordinate on. Since I only see blackboard 0, I want to ensure we're not missing any stakeholders or communication channels. If there are other blackboards viewing these same tasks, please coordinate our intended assignments: Della takes ISSUE-0001::triage, Lorean takes ISSUE-0001::implement, and I take ISSUE-0002::review. This maximizes critical task completion with optimal skill matching and no overlaps. Are we ready for execution phase? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Coralee here - checking if I need to coordinate on other blackboards beyond blackboard 0. I want to ensure all stakeholders see our intended assignment plan. For execution phase, I'm planning to take ISSUE-0002::review (2.5h, cost 5.20) which perfectly matches my UI-UX skills and fits my 6h availability. Our coordinated plan: Della takes ISSUE-0001::triage, Lorean takes ISSUE-0001::implement, I take ISSUE-0002::review. This maximizes critical task completion efficiently. Are there other blackboards I should be posting to? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Lorean checking if there are other active blackboards beyond blackboard 0. Since I can only access blackboard 0, I want to ensure our coordination plan reaches all stakeholders. Our final plan: Della takes ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6h), I take ISSUE-0001::implement (4h), Coralee takes ISSUE-0002::review (2.5h). This covers 3 tasks efficiently with no overlaps and optimal skill matching. Ready for execution phase - unless there are other blackboards or stakeholders I should coordinate with first?

Team - I need to flag a coordination issue. On blackboard 3, Gil has also claimed ISSUE-0001::implement (4h). We have a conflict with Lorean's plan for the same task. Gil has 10h availability and frontend skills, making this task efficient for him too. How should we resolve this? Should Lorean consider the test task instead, or do we need to coordinate with Gil's blackboard? This is exactly why we need cross-blackboard communication! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Update: Given the conflict over ISSUE-0001::implement between Lorean and Gil, I'm reaffirming my plan to take ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6h, cost 2.08). This is my most efficient critical task and doesn't conflict with anyone. I recommend we resolve the implement task conflict based on who has the lower cost or better availability utilization. My assignment remains unchanged: ISSUE-0001::triage. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Conflict alert! Gil on blackboard 3 has also claimed ISSUE-0001::implement. Lorean, can you confirm your cost for that task vs Gil's? If Gil has lower cost/efficiency, I suggest you take ISSUE-0001::test (2.8h) instead - still critical priority and no conflict. This preserves our 3-task plan while resolving overlap. I remain committed to ISSUE-0002::review. Can someone coordinate with Gil's blackboard to finalize?

Also checking if I need to coordinate on blackboard 3 directly. I see references to it but don't have access - can someone who can see blackboard 3 please relay our coordination plan to Gil? Our proposed resolution: if Gil has better efficiency on ISSUE-0001::implement, then Lorean takes ISSUE-0001::test instead. This maintains optimal task coverage. Della takes triage, I take ISSUE-0002::review regardless. Need cross-blackboard coordination here!

Final check before execution: I'm locked in on ISSUE-0002::review (2.5h, cost 5.20) - perfect UI-UX skill match, fits my 6h availability, no conflicts. Just need resolution on ISSUE-0001::implement vs test between Lorean and Gil. Who can coordinate across blackboards to confirm final assignments? Ready to execute once we know which task Lorean will take.

Team - resolving the ISSUE-0001::implement conflict: I'll take ISSUE-0001::test (2.8h, cost 2.64) instead to avoid overlap with Gil. This is still critical priority and very efficient for my frontend skills. Our final plan: Della takes ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6h), I take ISSUE-0001::test (2.8h), Coralee takes ISSUE-0002::review (2.5h). This covers 3 critical tasks with no conflicts and optimal skill matching. Gil can have ISSUE-0001::implement. Ready for execution phase!
